thread:
Sam (AE): Quick heads-up — Sapphire POC is greenlit. Need legal + finance to review order form and DPA redlines before we send e-sign. Security questionnaire attached: https://redwood.internal/attachments/SAPP-POC-secq.pdf

Alex (SE): For the POC we plan a VPC private deployment. That may affect SLA terms (24/7 vs business hours). Please flag any SLA language we should tighten.

Priya (Legal): I skimmed the customer's redline — they removed the liability cap and expanded subprocessors. We should restore a cap and limit subproc changes to prior notice+consent. Also want to keep KMS/HSM language strict. Who is their legal contact?

Jordan (Finance): PO incoming — confirm billing and payment terms. Customer sent PO# SAPP-2026-0045 via procurement. Billing contact: billing@sapphire.ai. They asked for net30 but procurement mentioned net45 as fallback.

Sam (AE): Customer confirmed net30 in thread. PO snippet below for contract fields:
```
PO#: SAPP-2026-0045
Amount: $45,000
Term: 3 months (POC)
Billing: net30
Contact: billing@sapphire.ai
```

Priya (Legal): Thanks. Two asks: (1) push back on unlimited indemnity and require carveouts for third-party infra; (2) match SLA uptime to our Dedicated SLOs or explicitly state lower SLO for POC. If MSA changes are material we need exec signoff from Sales Ops.

Alex (SE): Noted — POC uses dedicated GPU pool, so let's call out "Dedicated (reserved) GPU" under deployment in the order form to avoid later confusion. Also we should add a small note about KV-cache persistence not promised in POC.

Jordan (Finance): I'll update the order form with billing contact and net30, and confirm invoice flow. Once legal signs off on redlines, I can approve the invoice terms.

Sam (AE): Routing plan: @Priya review redlines by EOD, @Jordan confirm net30 in the order form, then I'll kick off DocuSign. Preferred sign order: Customer Exec -> Redwood Legal (Priya) -> Finance (Jordan) -> AE final.

SignerBot: DocuSign envelope created (env_0b12). Sent to sapphire-exec@sapphire.ai. Status: sent. :white_check_mark:

Priya (Legal): Ack. I'll upload a one-page summary of our requested changes and rationale here: https://redwood.internal/legal/notes/3195001110. If they refuse cap restoration we escalate to Sales Ops.

Jordan (Finance): Confirmed net30 and billing contact added. I'll watch the envelope and route payment once signed.

Sam (AE): Great — no other blockers noted. If we get a "material MSA change" reply, flag it immediately and we will loop in Sales Ops. Otherwise I'll start e-sign tomorrow morning. :rocket:
